title: A Survey on Awesome Korean NLP Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying the KHateSpeech dataset, which uses human annotations on scraped malicious online news comments to indicate the presence of gender bias.
Surveying the KHateSpeech dataset, which provides human-labeled annotations on entertainment and celebrity news comments to detect the broader existence of social bias.
Surveying the Toxic Comment dataset, which evaluates negative movie reviews using 5-dimensional vector labels to identify identity hate alongside other toxic attributes.
